purpose: Teach: 至急/台帳/雇い/シンクタンク/区民/区内/チームワーク/不明確

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察より、本気で、絶対、至急、絶対、ご対応、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We appreciate your urgent attention to this matter. Thank you sincerely.
lines.style: Professional, measured cadence. Opening with clear authority but not coldness. Steady pace, slight pause before the thanks—genuine rather than formulaic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、台帳、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご確認、絶対、頂きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've reviewed our records thoroughly and appreciate your verification.
lines.style: Attentive and cooperative. Lean slightly forward on 'reviewed'—showing engagement. Even tempo, respectful pause before gratitude.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察への、本気で、絶対、新規、絶対、雇い、絶対、入れ、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're moving forward with new protocols in coordination with your department. Thank you.
lines.style: Procedural but warm. Clear articulation on each step. Measured pace—not rushing, showing care in the process. Slight emphasis on 'coordination.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防犯の、本気で、絶対、シンクタンク、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been introduced to a crime prevention think tank through your recommendation. We're grateful.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the voice. Slightly brighter than before—opening up a little. Steady pace, warmth settling in around the word 'grateful.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 区民、本気で、絶対、安全のため、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Community safety is crucial, and we're committed to strengthening patrol presence in this ward.
lines.style: Calm conviction. Strong opening on 'Community.' Even, authoritative pace. Final phrase delivered with quiet resolve—not lecturing, affirming shared responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。区内、本気で、絶対、防犯カメラ、絶対、設置、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're installing additional security cameras throughout the ward and moving quickly on that.
lines.style: Practical and focused. Brisk but not hurried. Light emphasis on 'additional'—showing tangible progress. Confident close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察と、本気で、絶対、企業の、絶対、チームワーク、絶対、大切ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Police and private sector coordination really is essential. That's clear to us.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Slower pace on the opening thought. Genuine acknowledgment—not just procedural agreement. Slight exhale of alignment on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書の、本気で、絶対、不明確、絶対、な部分、絶対、警察様に、絶対、再度、絶対、ご確認いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Any unclear sections in our reports—we'll review those again with you right away. Thank you.
lines.style: Careful, thorough. Gentle emphasis on 'unclear'—showing attentiveness, not defensiveness. Close out with quiet professionalism and genuine gratitude. Slight lean-in quality.
